# BeatGridSegment { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGridSegment }

```python
timelines.BeatGridSegment(start, bpm, policy, battito, end=None)
```

One tempo segment of a beat grid: an anchor beat and how it repeats.

The segment stores only what a source states. Beat and bar lengths,
and the first downbeat, are derived from those facts rather than
stored beside them.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name    | Type                                        | Description                                                                                       |
|---------|---------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| start   | [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`)            | Seconds at which the anchor beat sounds.                                                          |
| bpm     | [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`)            | Beats per minute; one beat is one tick of the lattice.                                            |
| policy  | [BeatPolicy](`timetoalign.core.BeatPolicy`) | How the lattice beats group into bars. ``policy.name`` carries the meter as the source spells it. |
| battito | [int](`int`)                                | The 1-based beat-in-bar index of the anchor beat.                                                 |
| end     | [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`) \| None    | Exclusive bound in seconds, or ``None`` for a segment that generates beats without end.           |
